about:
Topper Town has operated from Albuquerque, New Mexico since 1983 as a family-owned business. The company began serving local truck owners with accessories and installation services, building a reputation over four decades of hands-on experience in the region.

The shop supplies and professionally installs a range of truck accessories including camper shells, tonneau covers, bed liners, toolboxes, and racks. Each product is selected for durability, safety, and ease of use, and the installation work focuses on proper sealing and long-term performance. The facility on Osuna Road NE serves as both a showroom and installation bay.

Customers include individual truck owners and commercial fleets across the Albuquerque area who need weather protection, cargo security, and organized storage. The team advises on product choices based on work demands, travel habits, and local climate conditions such as intense sun, dust, and sudden weather changes.

The company emphasizes honest guidance without pressure tactics, drawing recommendations from real-world use rather than guesswork. Local knowledge of Albuquerque roads and weather informs every sale and installation, and many customers return years later for upgrades or refer coworkers and family.
